result.summary: Worktree variant of GIT_MERGE.md applied end-to-end (this checkout is a secondary git worktree per `git worktree list`, alongside /home/tvolodi/letflow which holds local main). Staged this handoff file itself as a pre-merge commit so it would ride along in the PR/squash-merge. `git fetch origin main` + `git rebase origin/main`: 39 commits replayed; 4 distinct files conflicted across two rounds (docs/status/requirement_status.yaml, handoffs/orchestrator.log, handoffs/registry.json -- all append-only logs, resolved by composing/concatenating both sides rather than picking one, no content lost; docs/migration/stage-2-event-store-definitions.md -- a semantic conflict on the Stage 2 header's done/pending requirement lists, HEAD already had REQ-026 done while MINE already had REQ-036 done, composed into one line listing both REQ-026 and REQ-036 as done and removing both from pending). All 4 files within the <=5 limit, none under the excluded paths (process_instance.ex/instance_supervisor.ex/migrations). Verified no leftover conflict markers via grep and validated registry.json as JSON / requirement_status.yaml as YAML before continuing. Explicitly deleted the remote branch ref via `gh api -X DELETE repos/tvolodi/letflow/git/refs/heads/feature/WF02-REQ036-20260817` and, once off the branch via `git checkout --detach origin/main`, deleted the local branch via `git branch -d`. Verified: git rev-parse HEAD == git rev-parse origin/main == a1e1ad7a3cfad14f5b42442acb225d9aeaa73225, git log --oneline -1 shows the squash-merge commit (#105), git status shows a clean working tree with HEAD detached at origin/main (expected under the worktree variant, not a failure). Re-verified green on the actual merged tip: mix compile --warnings-as-errors exited clean, MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test: 4 properties, 536 tests, 0 failures (536 vs the run's earlier 500 reflects tests added by REQ-026, which landed on main concurrently and was picked up by this rebase -- not a regression or scope change in this run's own work).
